t: A small self-driving car kit for learning robot autonomy and AI.
steps: Buy the Duckiebot DB21 kit from the Duckietown Store.
Set up a laptop with Ubuntu and Docker.
Install the dts command line tool from the Duckietown docs.
Build the robot with the DB21J assembly guide. Plan for about three to four hours.
Flash the microSD card with dts and boot the robot.
Drive the robot with the keyboard control demo.
Try the lane following demo on a taped road.
Join the free Self-Driving Cars with Duckietown online course.
